definition: A stable partner identity or anonymized partner key is sufficient to recover the target.
prevention_rule: Run partner-ID and identity-permutation cheap baselines before candidate implementation.
stop_condition: best faithful partner-ID or partner-key baseline reaches or exceeds the task threshold

definition: Candidate behavior is equivalent to the label generator, oracle-shaped rules, or target-producing helper logic.
prevention_rule: Isolate candidate code from generator code and run independent oracle-shape and label-generator equivalence challengers.
stop_condition: candidate score equals label-generator or oracle-shaped shortcut score

definition: Trace lookup, pair counts, n-gram history, graph/cache families, or table baselines match the candidate.
prevention_rule: Make lookup and graph/cache challengers primary contrasts in preflight and discovery mode.
stop_condition: any faithful lookup/history/cache baseline ties or beats candidate or reaches no-candidate invalidation threshold

definition: A leakage scanner can report clean without proving it catches injected leakage.
prevention_rule: Require at least one positive-control leakage case for every admission-grade scanner.
stop_condition: leakage scanner lacks positive control or fails to detect injected leakage

definition: A candidate path is built before cheap baselines establish whether the task family is already shortcut-solvable.
prevention_rule: Run no-candidate baseline preflight before candidate code or task-family repair.
stop_condition: candidate code is proposed or created before cheap-baseline preflight completes

definition: The process repeatedly patches the same collapsed task family instead of changing the evidence target.
prevention_rule: Close the family after faithful baseline equivalence and require a new problem definition before reopening.
stop_condition: a proposed next task repairs a closed family without explicit new problem definition and stronger baseline separation

definition: Reports, schemas, anchors, or clean checks are produced without a route decision or new mechanism-discriminative evidence.
prevention_rule: Classify artifacts that do not change route decisions as governance-only, not evidence of mechanism progress.
stop_condition: task output produces only cleaner reports or anchors without changing route decision or preserving negative evidence

definition: Consecutive governance or hygiene tasks accumulate without new mechanism signal, negative signal, or route closure.
prevention_rule: Trigger route review after two consecutive governance-only or hygiene-only tasks without new signal.
stop_condition: two consecutive tasks are governance_only or hygiene_only and neither changes a downstream route

definition: Task conclusions are made without current source pins or with claims exceeding available computed evidence.
source_task_or_doc: AGENTS.md operating contract and source-pin readbacks across Gate4 records
prevention_rule: Require current repo readback, source pins, claim ceiling, and no downstream authorization flags before closeout.
stop_condition: source boundary is missing, remote/local anchor cannot be verified, or claim ceiling is absent
